NASB.1: Now the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NASB.2: 'See, I have called by name Bezalel, the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
NASB.3: 'I have filled him with the Spirit of God in wisdom, in understanding, in knowledge, and in all [kinds of] craftsmanship,
NASB.4: to make artistic designs for work in gold, in silver, and in bronze,
NASB.5: and in the cutting of stones for settings, and in the carving of wood, that he may work in all [kinds of] craftsmanship.
NASB.6: 'And behold, I Myself have appointed with him Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; and in the hearts of all who are skillful I have put skill, that they may make all that I have commanded you:
NASB.7: the tent of meeting, and the ark of testimony, and the mercy seat upon it, and all the furniture of the tent,
NASB.8: the table also and its utensils, and the pure [gold] lampstand with all its utensils, and the altar of incense,
NASB.9: the altar of burnt offering also with all its utensils, and the laver and its stand,
NASB.10: the woven garments as well, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, [with which] to carry on their priesthood;
NASB.11: the anointing oil also, and the fragrant incense for the holy place, they are to make [them] according to all that I have commanded you.'
NASB.12: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NASB.13: 'But as for you, speak to the sons of Israel, saying, 'You shall surely observe My sabbaths; for [this] is a sign between Me and you throughout your generations, that you may know that I am the LORD who sanctifies you.
NASB.14: 'Therefore you are to observe the sabbath, for it is holy to you. Everyone who profanes it shall surely be put to death; for whoever does any work on it, that person shall be cut off from among his people.
NASB.15: 'For six days work may be done, but on the seventh day there is a sabbath of complete rest, holy to the LORD; whoever does any work on the sabbath day shall surely be put to death.
NASB.16: 'So the sons of Israel shall observe the sabbath, to celebrate the sabbath throughout their generations as a perpetual covenant.'
NASB.17: 'It is a sign between Me and the sons of Israel forever; for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, but on the seventh day He ceased [from labor], and was refreshed.'
NASB.18: When He had finished speaking with him upon Mount Sinai, He gave Moses the two tablets of the testimony, tablets of stone, written by the finger of God.

ESV.2: “See, I have called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah,
ESV.3: and I have filled him with the Spirit of God, with ability and intelligence, with knowledge and all craftsmanship,
ESV.4: to devise artistic designs, to work in gold, silver, and bronze,
ESV.5: in cutting stones for setting, and in carving wood, to work in every craft.
ESV.6: And behold, I have appointed with him Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan. And I have given to all able men ability, that they may make all that I have commanded you:
ESV.7: the tent of meeting, and the ark of the testimony, and the mercy seat that is on it, and all the furnishings of the tent,
ESV.8: the table and its utensils, and the pure lampstand with all its utensils, and the altar of incense,
ESV.9: and the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the basin and its stand,
ESV.10: and the finely worked garments,  the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments of his sons, for their service as priests,
ESV.11: and the anointing oil and the fragrant incense for the Holy Place. According to all that I have commanded you, they shall do.”
ESV.12: And the LORD said to Moses,
ESV.13: “You are to speak to the people of Israel and say, ‘Above all you shall keep my Sabbaths, for this is a sign between me and you throughout your generations, that you may know that I, the LORD, sanctify you.
ESV.14: You shall keep the Sabbath, because it is holy for you. Everyone who profanes it shall be put to death. Whoever does any work on it, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
ESV.15: Six days shall work be done, but the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, holy to the LORD. Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day shall be put to death.
ESV.16: Therefore the people of Israel shall keep the Sabbath, observing the Sabbath throughout their generations, as a covenant forever.
ESV.17: It is a sign forever between me and the people of Israel that in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested and was refreshed.’”
ESV.18: And he gave to Moses, when he had finished speaking with him on Mount Sinai, the two tablets of the testimony, tablets of stone, written with the finger of God.

NLT.1: Then the LORD said to Moses,
NLT.2: “Look, I have specifically chosen Bezalel son of Uri, grandson of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
NLT.3: I have filled him with the Spirit of God, giving him great wisdom, ability, and expertise in all kinds of crafts.
NLT.4: He is a master craftsman, expert in working with gold, silver, and bronze.
NLT.5: He is skilled in engraving and mounting gemstones and in carving wood. He is a master at every craft!
NLT.6: “And I have personally appointed Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, to be his assistant. Moreover, I have given special skill to all the gifted craftsmen so they can make all the things I have commanded you to make:
NLT.7:
the Tabernacle;
the Ark of the Covenant;
the Ark’s cover — the place of atonement;
all the furnishings of the Tabernacle;
NLT.8:
the table and its utensils;
the pure gold lampstand with all its accessories;
the incense altar;
NLT.9:
the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils;
the washbasin with its stand;
NLT.10: the beautifully stitched garments — the sacred garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments for his sons to wear as they minister as priests;
NLT.11:
the anointing oil;
the fragrant incense for the Holy Place.
The craftsmen must make everything as I have commanded you.”
NLT.12: The LORD then gave these instructions to Moses:
NLT.13: “Tell the people of Israel: ‘Be careful to keep my Sabbath day, for the Sabbath is a sign of the covenant between me and you from generation to generation. It is given so you may know that I am the LORD, who makes you holy.
NLT.14: You must keep the Sabbath day, for it is a holy day for you. Anyone who desecrates it must be put to death; anyone who works on that day will be cut off from the community.
NLT.15: You have six days each week for your ordinary work, but the seventh day must be a Sabbath day of complete rest, a holy day dedicated to the LORD. Anyone who works on the Sabbath must be put to death.
NLT.16: The people of Israel must keep the Sabbath day by observing it from generation to generation. This is a covenant obligation for all time.
NLT.17: It is a permanent sign of my covenant with the people of Israel. For in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, but on the seventh day he stopped working and was refreshed.’”
NLT.18: When the LORD finished speaking with Moses on Mount Sinai, he gave him the two stone tablets inscribed with the terms of the covenant, written by the finger of God.

AMP.1: Now the LORD said to Moses,
AMP.2: "See, I have called by name Bezalel, son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
AMP.3: I have filled him with the Spirit of God in wisdom and skill, in understanding and intelligence, in knowledge, and in all kinds of craftsmanship,
AMP.4: to make artistic designs for work in gold, in silver, and in bronze,
AMP.5: and in the cutting of stones for settings, and in the carving of wood, to work in all kinds of craftsmanship.
AMP.6: And behold, I Myself have appointed with him Oholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; to all who are wise-hearted I have given the skill and ability to make everything that I have commanded you:
AMP.7: the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the Testimony, the mercy seat that is upon it, all the furnishings of the tent—
AMP.8: the table [for the bread] and its utensils, the pure gold lampstand with all its utensils, the [golden] altar of incense,
AMP.9: the [bronze] altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, the basin and its base—
AMP.10: the finely worked garments, the holy garments for Aaron the [high] priest and the garments for his sons to minister as priests,
AMP.11: and the anointing oil and the sweet and fragrant incense for the Holy Place. They are to make them according to all that I have commanded you."
AMP.12: And the LORD said to Moses,
AMP.13: "But as for you, say to the Israelites, 'You shall most certainly observe My Sabbaths, for it is a sign between Me and you throughout your generations, so that you may know [without any doubt] and acknowledge that I am the LORD who sanctifies you and sets you apart [for Myself].
AMP.14: Therefore, you shall keep the Sabbath, for it is holy to you. Everyone who profanes it must be put to death; for whoever does work on the Sabbath, that person (soul) shall be cut off from among his people [excluding him from the atonement made for them].
AMP.15: For six days work may be done, but the seventh is the Sabbath of complete rest, sacred to the LORD; whoever does work on the Sabbath day must be put to death.
AMP.16: So the Israelites shall observe the Sabbath, to celebrate the Sabbath throughout their generations as a perpetual covenant.'
AMP.17: It is a sign between Me and the Israelites forever; for in six days the LORD made the heavens and the earth, and on the seventh day He ceased and was refreshed."
AMP.18: When He had finished speaking with him on Mount Sinai, He gave Moses the two tablets of the Testimony, tablets of stone, written with the finger of God.

NIV.10: and also the woven garments, both the sacred garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons when they serve as priests,
NIV.11: and the anointing oil and fragrant incense for the Holy Place. They are to make them just as I commanded you.”
NIV.12:
The Sabbath
Then the Lord said to Moses,
NIV.13: “Say to the Israelites, ‘You must observe my Sabbaths. This will be a sign between me and you for the generations to come, so you may know that I am the Lord, who makes you holy.
NIV.14: “‘Observe the Sabbath, because it is holy to you. Anyone who desecrates it must be put to death; whoever does any work on that day must be cut off from his people.
NIV.15: For six days, work is to be done, but the seventh day is a Sabbath of rest, holy to the Lord. Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day must be put to death.
NIV.16: The Israelites are to observe the Sabbath, celebrating it for the generations to come as a lasting covenant.
NIV.17: It will be a sign between me and the Israelites forever, for in six days the Lord made the heavens and the earth, and on the seventh day he abstained from work and rested.’”
NIV.18: When the Lord finished speaking to Moses on Mount Sinai, he gave him the two tablets of the Testimony, the tablets of stone inscribed by the finger of God.

NET.2: “See, I have chosen Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah,
NET.3: and I have filled him with the Spirit of God in skill, in understanding, in knowledge, and in all kinds of craftsmanship,
NET.4: to make artistic designs for work with gold, with silver, and with bronze,
NET.5: and with cutting and setting stone, and with cutting wood, to work in all kinds of craftsmanship.
NET.6: Moreover, I have also given him Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, and I have given ability to all the specially skilled, that they may make everything I have commanded you:
NET.7: the tent of meeting, the ark of the testimony, the atonement lid that is on it, all the furnishings of the tent,
NET.8: the table with its utensils, the pure lampstand with all its utensils, the altar of incense,
NET.9: the altar for the burnt offering with all its utensils, the large basin with its base,
NET.10: the woven garments, the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons, to minister as priests,
NET.11: the anointing oil, and sweet incense for the Holy Place. They will make all these things just as I have commanded you.”
NET.13: “Tell the Israelites, ‘Surely you must keep my Sabbaths, for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations, that you may know that I am the LORD who sanctifies you.
NET.14: So you must keep the Sabbath, for it is holy for you. Everyone who defiles it must surely be put to death; indeed, if anyone does any work on it, then that person will be cut off from among his people.

NET.17: It is a sign between me and the Israelites forever; for in six days the LORD made the heavens and the earth, and on the seventh day he rested and was refreshed.’”
